title: Electron IPC & Renderer Safety
description: Electron-specific security: renderer must not access Node directly; main-process exposure must be allowlisted.

rules.message: Enabling nodeIntegration in renderer is a full RCE primitive for any XSS.
rules.remediation: Set nodeIntegration:false, contextIsolation:true, and route Node calls through a preload IPC bridge.

rules.message: Disabling contextIsolation lets renderer JS pollute preload's globals — privilege escalation.
rules.remediation: Keep contextIsolation:true. Use contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld for explicit API surface.

rules.message: Renderer-side file (panel/src) directly importing a Node builtin — must route through preload.
rules.remediation: Move the call into electron/main.ts, expose via contextBridge, consume from renderer.

rules.message: webPreferences without sandbox:true — preload runs unsandboxed; broader attack surface.
rules.remediation: Add `sandbox: true` to webPreferences when feasible.
